overview_description.description:
uRento is a multi-functional app that helps small to medium-scale landlords manage their properties from a single platform. Be it residential or commercial properties, we want to help the landlords to do business in an efficient and cost-effective manner by embracing digital transformation. 

From the most basic need, such as collecting rent, to key operational needs, such as managing timely maintenance, we want landlords to do it all through uRento’s easy-to-use one-stop shop platform.
